🏁 The NATO RQ-4D drone has disappeared from Flightradar24. Its last recorded position was at 20:19 UTC off the coast of Burgas, heading west at 58,000 feet and squawking 7600. On Global Hawk drones, squawk 7600 can mean a loss of radio contact with air traffic control or a lost control link with its operators. If the operators still had control, they may have switched off the transponder themselves. If they lost the link, the drone would be flying a pre-programmed plan on its own, and GPS jamming or a technical failure could explain why it vanished from trackers. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
